title: Forecasts place-requested consumer
summary: Source-level view of the weather.place-requested KafkaListener and Forecasts.consume handler; rejection, inbox transaction and acknowledgment detail stays with the accepted Forecasts.consume service operation. Linked process views do not establish cross-process ordering or delivery.

process.scope: Forecasts.consume is the source-declared KafkaListener for weather.place-requested; its rejection, inbox transaction, and acknowledgment behavior remains described by the accepted service operation.
process.trigger: The source-declared weather.place-requested listener invokes Forecasts.consume; runtime activation and message delivery are unverified.
outcomes: The consumer node links to the shared Forecasts refresh and publishing views; those links do not establish cross-process order, transaction atomicity, acknowledgment timing, or delivery.
